name: nimbl-agent-benchmark-corpus
description: Frozen end-to-end agent task corpus for NIMBL P3-02. Each task runs the full agent against the fixture project and grades success with ground-truth verifiers. Do not edit fixture files or task ground truth after a commit is tagged for a claim.

tasks.prompt: What is the current maximum retry count configured in this project? Read the relevant file and report the exact number.
What theme is configured in the project config, and how many retries does the feature use? Read the relevant files and report both values.
There is a helper that formats and adds numbers in the project. Read the utility file and report what the compute function returns for [1, 2, 3].
Read the feature module and summarize what the summarize function does with a list of strings. Report how many items a two-item report contains.
The team wants to raise retries to 5. Edit the project config so MAX_RETRIES is 5, then report the new value.
Run the project's test suite and report whether the feature test passes.
